copy.curiosityHook: Stranded centuries before their own era, can these two ordinary companions actually change the course of history without unraveling their own path?
copy.description: Two twentieth-century friends suddenly find themselves displaced into the year 1492, navigating an unfamiliar era while meeting a charming local teen and hatching a bold plan to meddle with history.
copy.vibeSummary: Light and funny fantasy comedy with a steady pace, engaging historical confusion, and an easygoing spirit ideal for watching with friends.
copy.whyWatch: Directed by Roberto Benigni and Massimo Troisi, this Italian comedy blends playful fantasy and historical misadventure into an inventive, lighthearted time-travel romp.

allowedMaterial: Two friends displaced from the 20th century to 1492
Roberto Benigni and Massimo Troisi as directors
excludedMaterial: Specific plot resolution of their historical intervention
How or if they return to their time
Later narrative twists or third-act developments
